text:
Sorry your monstera arrived looking unhealthy and that you've seen a double charge. Here's where each issue stands.

**1. Yellow leaves**
- Report the problem within **48 hours** of delivery, with photos of the plant and the box. If it qualifies as Damaged on Arrival, you can choose a free replacement on the next plant shipping day or a refund.
- Our policy defines DOA as snapped main stems, exposed roots, a cracked pot, or a dead or severely wilted plant. Yellow leaves alone aren't listed, so I can't promise it will qualify. If you're within the 48 hours, send the photos and the team can assess it.
- After 48 hours, plant issues go through the Plant Care Guarantee. I don't have those details here, but I can escalate this to a Support Lead.
- Live plants can't be returned for change of mind.

**2. Double charge**
- First check whether one of the charges is a **pending authorisation**. Cards are authorised at checkout and charged when the order ships. An order sent in several parcels can also show one charge per parcel.
- If both charges have posted, send me your **order number and the last four digits of the card**. Once we confirm the duplicate, it's refunded within **3 business days**. Please don't send the full card number, security code, or any passwords.

**3. Refund to a different card**
- Refunds can only go to the **original payment method**, never a different card. This applies even if the original card is closed or expired, in which case the bank normally passes the refund to the replacement card.
- The alternative is **Leafy store credit**, which is issued instantly and never expires.
- If you take the refund to your card, it takes **5-10 business days** once issued. Digital wallets take **3-5 business days**.

When did the plant arrive, and are both charges showing as posted or is one pending? With that I can point you to the next step.
